new_lessons.L15: self-updating service 必带 self-restart trigger. edge-pull.ts 改自己 → git pull 拉新 source → systemd 进程仍 in-memory 旧代码 (disk 更新不触发 reload). 修法 4 选 1: A handler self-restart via mtime check / B CI deploy.yml ssh systemctl restart / C tsx --watch (dev only) / D systemd ExecStartPost. 推荐 B (CI 加 ssh step) 最干净 + 可控.
new_lessons.L16: tsc --incremental 在 small codebase 收益有限 (~2-5s, not 30s→1s). tsc 必须 traverse 整个 type graph 才能判断 changed files, 即使 cache hit 也需 ~3s. 大型 codebase (1k+ files) --incremental 收益显著; 小型主要受益于 elapsed_ms 观测性. 进一步优化: tsc --build + project references / swc / esbuild (10-100x faster).
new_lessons.L17: 39s 真正 wins 不在 tsc --incremental 而是 compose up 决定不 recreate (image unchanged + bind-mount). v1.2.0e.2 39s 分解: git pull 1s + full tsc 15-20s + compose recreate 15-20s. v1.2.0e.3 5.2s 分解: git pull 0.7s + incremental tsc 4s + compose noop 0.25s. 优化 deploy pipeline 时先 profile 找 dominant cost, 别假设.
new_lessons.L18: HTTP response body 加 elapsed_ms 让外部 monitoring 0 依赖. webhook 慢时只能 ssh 上 edge 翻 journalctl (旧模式). handler 直接写 elapsed_ms 进 JSON response, GH Actions step / external monitor 可直接 parse, 便于 SLO 监控. 任何 webhook / RPC handler 必带 timing field.

v1.2.0e.4_self_restart_closure.status: ✅ v1.2.0e.4 chicken-and-egg cycle CLOSED @ HEAD `e20d946` main (2026-09-10). 2 commits + 2 file changes (edge-pull.ts +34 行 Step 4 + edge-webhook.test.ts +74 行 +2 tests + makeDetachedSpawn helper) + 2 tags (v1.2.0e.4 + v1.2.0e.4-rerun). Step 4 (handler self-restart): after compose up ok, spawn('systemctl', ['restart', 'edge-webhook.service', '--no-block'], {detached: true, stdio: 'ignore'}) + unref() + try/catch + on('error') warn. Design choices: (1) detached:true + unref() so child doesn't keep parent alive, (2) --no-block so systemctl returns immediately and systemd schedules async restart, (3) try/catch wraps spawn — failure non-fatal (next webhook will pick up new code), (4) restartMs added to elapsed_ms observability payload. 193 unit tests passed (was 191, +2 new: 'invokes systemctl restart --no-block with detached option after compose up' + 'survives systemctl spawn error (returns 200 even if restart fails)'); full suite 193/165/0. 3 CI matrix runs: 34434159420 (initial deploy, 4/7 PASS edge1+edge2 webhook ok + edge3/4/5 missing secrets) + 34434707775 (verify-noop, HEAD == 6acdd7e so handler returned early noop, PID didn't change → bumped README) + 34435000831 (verify-rerun, HEAD e20d946 != 6acdd7e → full reload path executed → self-restart spawn fired → PID changed on both edges). Real-edge proof (run 34435000831 journal): edge1=puer-hk OLD PID 334387 → NEW PID 341361 (systemctl show MainPID=341350, ExecMainStartTimestamp=03:54:25 UTC), log sequence 'git pull ok (1126ms)' → 'tsc ok (2720ms)' → 'compose up ok (239ms)' → 'self-restart scheduled (4ms; --no-block)' → 'ok; pulled e20d9461f4dd + reloaded; total=4085ms (pull=1126 build=2720 compose=239 restart=4)' → 'SIGTERM received; closing' → new tsx[341361] listening on 127.0.0.1:7777. edge2=hk OLD PID 970181 → NEW PID 970484 (systemctl show MainPID=970472, ExecMainStartTimestamp=03:54:26 UTC), log sequence 'git pull ok (1103ms)' → 'tsc ok (3317ms)' → 'compose up ok (189ms)' → 'self-restart scheduled (2ms; --no-block)' → 'ok; pulled e20d9461f4dd + reloaded; total=4609ms (pull=1103 build=3317 compose=189 restart=2)' → 'SIGTERM received; closing' → new tsx[970484] listening on 127.0.0.1:7777. CONFIRMED: self-restart auto-triggered on next webhook delivery (after one-time manual restart per L19 paradox). 2 new lessons L15+L19 (M-bug class cycle #10): L15 self-updating service 必带 self-restart trigger (systemd unit ExecStart 启动时 load source, 运行时 source 更新不触发 reload → 需 spawn detached systemctl restart), L19 self-update paradox: 第一次部署 self-restart feature 时 OLD process 不知道该 self-restart, 必须 cycle closure 包含一次性手动 systemctl restart (无解, 只能文档化).
